name: Agent Proving Mission
problem: Teams can demo an agent but struggle to prove what it can reliably do under a bounded mission with evidence and review.
inputs: Agent/workflow under test, bounded mission, success criteria, allowed tools/environment and authority boundaries.
outputs: Mission criteria, observed attempts, competency evidence, decision traces and concise pass/gap report.
pricing: Current hypothesis $250-$2,500 per proving mission; not auto-quotable yet.
confirmation: Testing scope and external side effects require explicit authority. Paid execution requires confirmed terms and payment.
invocation_status: Discoverable capability; paid execution verification pending.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
